subject.title: fix(sessions): enforce exact owner equality for all parent session use

question: Should plugin runtimes intentionally fail closed on all legacy ownerless sessions when this isolation fix lands?
rationale: Exact equality prevents arbitrary plugin adoption but makes previously ownerless rows unusable to plugin runtimes, so the upgrade boundary needs explicit security and compatibility ownership.

options.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
options.body: Keep exact equality and require non-plugin or operator recovery for legacy ownerless sessions.

options.title: Add a trusted migration
options.body: Define and test a doctor or migration path that assigns legacy rows without permitting arbitrary plugin adoption.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
recommendation.body: Keep exact equality and require non-plugin or operator recovery for legacy ownerless sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work shows the strongest ownership of the Gateway session create and reset product boundary.
